annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (Jordan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets eight ethical principles: humanity and society, inclusiveness and justice, privacy and data, transparency, responsibility and accountability, reliability, integrity and non-fakeness, environment/green AI.
Includes principles for the virtual environment and metaverse.
Sets ethics rules for AI scientific research.
Ministry to receive complaints on AI ethics and assess damage from AI systems.
Encourages open-source models, open data, and disclosure of accuracy and error rates.
annotation.summary_en: Jordan's National AI Code of Ethics, issued by the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship in bilingual Arabic/English. It sets voluntary ethical principles for responsible AI (humanity, justice, privacy, transparency, accountability, reliability, integrity, green AI), metaverse principles, research ethics, non-compliance risks, and a complaints channel at the Ministry.
annotation.title_en: The National Artificial Intelligence Code of Ethics
annotation.venue: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (modee.gov.jo)
